items.title: Google Research posts six Cogentic papers written by a Gemini 4 agent, including an unconditional L[1/3] factoring proof
items.summary: Google Research added six math papers to its public google-research repo that it says the Cogentic multi-agent proof harness on Gemini 4 produced from a single prompt, covering factoring, discrete logs, Nash equilibria, log-rank and graph reconstruction. The Lean 4 formalizations are promised but not yet public and nothing is peer reviewed.

doubt.pushback: Lean proofs are not released and no outside review yet; the proven constant (105) is far above the number field sieve's ~1.9, so there is no practical crypto impact.

reception.summary: Repliers and quoters are impressed but want the Lean files before calling it a breakthrough, and several note it does not weaken RSA or ECC; one quoter questions a lab publicly targeting factoring.

items.title: MiniT2I text-to-image runs in the browser on WebGPU: MIT-licensed, int8, 313 MB, about 0.5 s per image
items.summary: An int8 WebGPU build of the compact MiniT2I model (originally 603M params from MIT and Kaiming He, compacted to 315M) generates images locally in the browser in about half a second, with a Hugging Face Space to try it.
items.vendor: MiniT2I (MIT); WebGPU port by Caleb Fahlgren

reception.summary: People who tried it call it tiny and very fast with early Stable Diffusion quality; one user hit a WebGPU start failure only after the full 313 MB download.

items.title: Transformers PR adds a last_loop KV cache mode for Inkling 2 that halves cache memory with identical output tokens
items.summary: A Hugging Face transformers pull request adds a dory-style last_loop cache mode for the looped Inkling 2 models, which keeps only the final loop's KV cache and cuts the cache footprint by about 50% while producing the same tokens.

items.title: TensorFold TFQ3 quantization gets a native CUDA runtime PR with 3, 4 and 5-bit kernels and drafters
items.summary: A TensorFold pull request brings its open TFQ quantization format to NVIDIA GPUs with native 3/4/5-bit kernels plus speculative drafters for Qwen3.8-27B, GLM-5.3-Flash and Flash Next, so TFQ3 models are no longer Metal-only.

doubt.pushback: PR is open, not merged, and no CUDA speed numbers in the post.

items.title: ishiki-asr-1.0 merges seven speech models into one 13B checkpoint and becomes the top open model on the Open ASR Leaderboard
items.summary: Ishiki Labs packed Qwen3-ASR, Cohere Transcribe, Whisper, Parakeet, Granite Speech and others into a single 13B checkpoint with a learned gate; it ranks first among open models (third overall) on the Hugging Face Open ASR Leaderboard and held up on the leaderboard team's private sets.

items.title: Reproducible tiny-voca TTS training recipe on Hugging Face Jobs: one GPU, about 5.5 hours, 1.26% WER
items.summary: A tested recipe re-runs the tiny-voca README end to end on Hugging Face Jobs (data prep, alignment, training, eval, ONNX export) on one GPU in about 5.5 hours, matching the release with 1.26% vs 1.36% test WER, and ships an AGENTS.md so a coding agent can run it.

items.title: DiffSynth-Studio adds multi-GPU sequence-parallel inference with EntroPack KV-cache compression
items.summary: ModelScope's DiffSynth-Studio can now split generation across several GPUs for most supported models and combine it with weight quantization and EntroPack INT8 KV-cache compression; on MiniMax-H3 5-second 720p video it reports 2.329 s per denoising step on 8 A100s.

items.title: EVIL benchmark: 269 court-case scenarios show most frontier models fall below 75% safety on illicit-intent requests
items.summary: OpenBMB's EVIL benchmark, published in Nature Communications, builds 269 illicit scenarios times 50 intents from real Chinese and US court cases and tests 10 frontier models; most score under 75% safety and GPT-4o stays under 60% in both legal contexts.

items.title: Sage-Interaction: a 9B open-weight full-duplex omni model that talks while delegating agent tasks in the background
items.summary: Shanghai AI Lab's Sage-Interaction, built on MiniCPM-o 4.5, combines full-duplex voice interaction with background task delegation; it reports 80.73 on FD-Bench v1.5 and 1.29 s turn-taking latency, with weights on ModelScope and Hugging Face.

items.title: PCIe Relaxed Ordering silently corrupted 63 of 400k GPU transfers on 4x RTX PRO 6000; hyperflare-inference merges a fix
items.summary: On a 4x RTX PRO 6000 box, PCIe Relaxed Ordering let CUDA report copies complete before the last bytes reached host RAM, corrupting 63 of 400,000 transfers with no CUDA error; the hyperflare-inference engine merged a fix for multi-GPU local serving.

doubt.pushback: Single-rig report; no repo link in the post.

items.title: NVIDIA TimeTravelContainer live-forks a running container so agents can branch stateful tool sessions
items.summary: NVIDIA's rootless TimeTravelContainer, built on gVisor, forks a running container's processes, memory, filesystem and network with copy-on-write on Linux, macOS and WSL2; on agentic EDA flows it reports 84.1x faster cloning, 31 to 72% less memory and 1.7 to 9.4x end-to-end speedups.

items.title: Delegent: Claude Code harness hands legwork to a local small model and cuts frontier cost 59 to 67% with no task loss
items.summary: A University of Waterloo harness keeps the frontier model in charge in unmodified Claude Code but routes subagent coding and search subtasks to a local SLM via a relay; with a 27B FP8 SLM it cuts frontier cost 67% on long-horizon coding and 59% on agentic search, and a 2B laptop model still saves 66% on coding.

items.title: Hugging Face trains harness adapters live in the open for Inkling-2-Mini and Qwen3.8-Flash-Next, with checkpoints and GGUFs public
items.summary: A fully open training run for harness adapters (Inkling-2-Mini on Pi, Hermes and DeepSeek-Harness; Qwen3.8-Flash-Next on Pi) publishes weights, data, experiments, decisions and intermediate GGUF checkpoints as it goes, with a live dashboard.

items.title: Ant Group introduces LingSante-Live, a real-time multimodal architecture for ongoing health guidance
items.summary: LingSante-Live splits a fast foreground responder from a slower background reasoner so perception and guidance follow a user's activity in real time; the thread shows the architecture, four demos and an evaluation.

doubt.pushback: No weights, paper or API link in the post; demos and self-reported evaluation only.

items.title: Google DevRel: rules and guardrails written for older models slow Gemini 4 Neon down; five changes that helped
items.summary: After weeks of evals with Gemini 4 Neon, Google's Philipp Schmid removed or rewrote older-model guardrails, skills and rules that the stronger model over-follows, in an X article with five concrete changes for agent prompt files.

doubt.pushback: No eval numbers in the post itself; repliers ask how safety and approval cases were checked after removing rules.

reception.summary: Repliers report the same effect after trimming rules files, with a few suggesting safety rules move into hooks rather than being deleted and asking how regressions were checked.

items.title: Tripo H3.5 Preview: image-to-3D model aimed at print-ready and game-ready assets
items.summary: Tripo AI released a preview of its H3.5 3D generation model, claiming closer fidelity to reference images and cleaner geometry for 3D printing and game asset pipelines.

doubt.pushback: Vendor claims and a sizzle clip; no benchmark or open access details.

items.title: Overnight autoresearch test: Gemini 4 Neon reaches 80% of Claude Fable 5.2's result at half the cost
items.summary: Given Karpathy's autoresearch GPT-training setup, H100s and a night without humans, Gemini 4 Neon reached about 80% of Fable 5.2's improvement while costing about half as much.

doubt.pushback: Single run by one tester, no repo or logs linked.

items.title: Living Brain memory system finds Lean lemmas that close 15 conjectures in a 17-million-line library
items.summary: Living Brain says its memory system, loaded with a 17M-line Lean library, retrieved the lemmas that, together with its OpenHuman agent, settled 15 conjectures; the product is live.

doubt.pushback: No list of the conjectures, proofs or Lean files linked; product announcement only.

reception.summary: Only one short reply; no one reports trying it.
